statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-26131 is a .NET elevation of privilege vulnerability on Linux caused by incorrect default permissions in .NET packaging (CWE-276). Microsoft lists the .NET 10 Linux runtime packages up to 10.0.3 as affected and 10.0.4 as the patched version (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/386, https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/125395, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.4/10.0.4.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0 through 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. In every build the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework directories carry that build's .NET version. The advisory does not say which permission was wrong, so this range follows Microsoft's version table: 10.0.2-r0 and 10.0.3-r0 carry .NET 10.0.2 and 10.0.3, which Microsoft lists as affected; 10.0.4-r0 is the first published build at .NET 10.0.4, and every later build carries a later release. The range ends at 10.0.4-r0 because it is the first published build at the patched version.
